Built around a foundation of nutty barley and sweet glutinous rice, this cold dish is prepared through precise steaming before being gently folded with sweet red azuki beans, crushed roasted chestnuts, and a fragrant brown sugar syrup infused with fresh ginger. A light dusting of toasted kinako soybean flour adds an earthy nutty aroma, while freshly grated yuzu zest elevates the overall profile with vibrant citrus notes. Perfect for summer gatherings, this dessert grain salad can be prepared ahead of time and served chilled in traditional ceramic glassware. The contrast between chewiness of cooked grains and velvety smooth bean paste creates a sophisticated finish to any formal meal. Packed with wholesome dietary fiber, essential B-complex vitamins, and rich plant-based proteins, it delivers a nutritious twist on classical Asian desserts. The complex syrup brings subtle caramel notes without overpowering the natural flavors of high-quality grains.
